title: The Effect of Social Media on Corporate Innovation: Evidence from Seeking Alpha Coverage
near_miss_reason: Underlying design is staggered binary SA coverage initiation (153 treated firms, cover_year 2011-2015), but every DiD regression is a stacked design on a PSM-matched sample: one stack per treated firm (153 cohort_ids, controls reused across stacks) with cohort-by-firm and cohort-by-year FE (absorb(firm_cohort year_cohort)), +/-3-year windows. Main innovation outcomes (Tables 4-5, 7-9) are ppmlhdfe (Poisson); linear columns (Table 6 financing/constraint outcomes, appendix patent-value/R&D outcomes) are stacked as well. Stacked DiD and matching-based DiD are excluded by PROTOCOL Sec. 2, so this is not a controls-only near-miss (same treatment as mnsc.2021.01914 and mnsc.2023.04127).
eligible_reason: No unstacked firm-year TWFE is reported; all DiD columns use firm_cohort and year_cohort FE on a stacked PSM-matched sample, and the headline columns are Poisson.
design_notes: DID_regression.dta: 5,796 rows, 153 treated firms (cover_year 2011: 45, 2012: 54, 2013: 29, 2014: 18, 2015: 7) and 157 PSM-matched control firms, event window [-3, 3] around initiation. Table 2: PSM probit and pre-event predictability. Table 4: ppmlhdfe patents/citations on treat_post (with and without lagged controls). Table 5: dynamic event-time indicators (Poisson). Table 6: reghdfe equity/debt issuance, financial-constraint indices on treat_post (with/without controls), stacked FE. Tables 7-9: split-sample Poisson by channel terciles. Tables 10-11: 2SLS with followers instrument on a firm-year panel with controls.

data_provenance_note: Regression samples (DID_regression.dta, PSM.dta, IV files) built from SA, Kogan et al. patents, CRSP, IBES, RavenPack and Compustat are shipped; no statement of synthetic data.
screener_notes: A plain TWFE could be built from the stacked file, but it is not a reported specification. 5b lists stacked-only papers under the modern-estimator near-miss sentence; coded near_miss false to match the 5c sense used for mnsc.2021.01914 and mnsc.2023.04127. Lead may override. Screened from package only.
